pr.d: Peppa and George are helping Grandpa Pig to dig a new pond for his garden. While digging, they find hidden treasure so they go to see Mr Richard in the museum.

Everyone is down at the lake as it's a perfect day to go boating. Miss Rabbit has all sorts of boats for hire and Daddy Pig picks one with pedals, but when all the families have a race, he soon wishes he had picked something easier to sail.
It's bedtime, but Peppa is not sleepy, so Daddy Pig tells Peppa and George a story about a pretty princess and a dinosaur.
Daddy Pig hangs his clean football shirt out to dry, but Peppa, George and Mummy splash it with mud. They put it in the wash, but Peppa puts her red dress in too, which turns Daddy's shirt pink.
Suzy and Peppa start a Secret Club where they go on secret missions, and do secret things, but soon everyone wants to join.
Rebecca Rabbit has a little brother called Richard who is the same age as George. George and Richard each have a toy dinosaur, but the boys are not very good at sharing their toys.
When a power cut plunges their house into darkness, Peppa and George have fun looking for a torch and thinking of games to play in the dark.

Mummy Pig is determined that George's new hat doesn't get muddy when Peppa and George visit Grandpa and Granny Pig. Everyone tries to make sure that it stays clean, even if it means that they get messy instead.

It's a beautiful day but Peppa, George and Grandpa Pig are sitting inside watching the motor racing on the television. Granny Pig shoos them all outside to enjoy the sunshine. Inspired by the racing, Grandpa Pig builds George his own racing car.
Peppa and the Pig family attend a school fête. Peppa's favourite things at the fête are face painting, the balloons, and the bouncy castle.

Daddy Pig loves to watch television, but Peppa Pig thinks that he needs to do some exercise. She says that Daddy Pig's tummy is looking a bit big. Daddy Pig disagrees but says that Peppa can be in charge of getting him fit. Peppa gives him lots of exercises to do, and Daddy Pig is exhausted by the end of the day.
Peppa and George visit Granny Pig, who is very excited about her new pet, a parrot called Polly.
Mummy Pig, Daddy Pig, Peppa and George go to the supermarket, and George sits in the trolley while Peppa finds the things on Mummy's shopping list.

George eats his breakfast too quickly and gets hiccups, so Peppa tries to help him get rid of them. After trying everything else, there is only one solution left for Peppa to cure him with - to scare him!
Peppa's friends are all riding their bicycles. Peppa is determined to learn to cycle without her stabilisers after she teases George about having a baby's tricycle.
Peppa loves secrets, so Mummy Pig makes her a special box to put secret things in.
Peppa, George, Mummy and Daddy enjoy flying a kite in the park until their kite gets tangled in a tree beside a big, muddy puddle.
When Daddy Pig and Mummy Pig are tidying up the house, they happen to find an old box of musical instruments. George makes a loud sound with the Swiss horn.
Ben and Holly save the day when Mr Elf forgets to deliver the last box of toys to Father Christmas.
The elf plane is forced to make an emergency landing en route to delivering the last batch of Christmas presents, but no one minds as it is an opportunity for them all to meet Father Christmas.
On Christmas Eve, both the elves and the fairies are busy with their festive preparations when things start to go very wrong.

The Christmas preparations have gone wrong. The king is trapped, the queen is packed along with the small castle as a gift, and the old elf is stuck in the Christmas tree section of the garden centre.

Daddy Pig loves to watch television, but Peppa Pig thinks that he needs to do some exercise. She says that Daddy Pig's tummy is looking a bit big. Daddy Pig disagrees but says that Peppa can be in charge of getting him fit. Peppa gives him lots of exercises to do, and Daddy Pig is exhausted by the end of the day.
It's raining, and Peppa is sad because she cannot play outside. However, when the rain stops, Peppa and George get to play one of their favourite games, namely jumping in muddy puddles.
Peppa's family go to the museum's moon exhibition with George's friend, Edmond Elephant.
Peppa and her friends go to help at Edmond Elephant's birthday party, but the little children are harder to look after than they'd thought.
Peppa and her family are at the swimming pool. George is a little worried at first but is soon splashing happily with his friend Richard Rabbit.
Playgroup is having a pet competition and everyone has brought their pets. Dr Hamster is the judge, but it is so hard to choose the best pet.
Peppa and family go on a walk through the forest where they meet all of their favourite fairytale characters. They visit the home of bears who like porridge and meet a hungry Mr Wolf.
While enjoying a tea break, Mr Bull accidentally breaks his delicate teapot. He takes the pieces to Miss Rabbit in the hope that she can mend it.
pr.sub: Mr Bull in a China Shop

pr.d: Blue has something exciting to tell everybody. Josh and the viewer go on a note finding quest, solving riddles, and following treasure maps to find out the answer to Blue's Big News.
Paddington meets Mateo's dog, and Paddington delivers Love Day cards to his friends.
pr.sub: Paddington Meets Lucky; Paddington and the Love Day Cards

pr.d: Ben Elf and his parents are going on holiday in the elf truck but Gaston the Ladybird has swallowed the car keys.
Lucy and her dad are having a relaxing day boating on the lake. They fish out an old glittery mirror from the bottom of the lake, but it belongs to a mermaid who would like it back.
Things are going missing all over the Little Kingdom - Holly has lost her wand and Ben has lost his horn! Soon they realise that ants are stealing their things.
Ben, Holly and Gaston the Ladybird find a large egg in the meadow.
Peppa and George have a fancy dress party and all their friends are invited. Peppa dresses as a fairy princess and George as a scary dinosaur.
Peppa and George go on a boat trip with Grandpa Pig, but they must send Polly Parrot for help when their boat runs aground. Polly fetches Granny Pig and Grandad Dog to rescue them.

Peppa has a new pen pal, a little donkey from France named Delphine. Peppa receives letters from Delphine Donkey and speaks to her on the telephone. Although Peppa speaks English and Delphine speaks French, they discover that they love lots of the same things, especially jumping up and down in muddy puddles.
Grandpa Pig is planting seeds to make a flower garden, but the birds keep eating them, so Peppa and George help Grandpa Pig to make a scarecrow, which stops the birds eating Grandpa's seeds.

Mummy and Daddy Pig let Peppa and George put their coats on over their pyjamas and go outside to look at the stars. With the help of a telescope, Daddy Pig teaches Peppa and George how to find the North Star.
Mummy Dog surprises Captain Daddy Dog with a gift of a boat trip for his birthday, but when Peppa and the gang come along, the trip doesn't go to plan.
Peppa and George visit Mr Fox's Shop to buy Granny and Grandpa an anniversary present, but have trouble choosing from the shop that sells everything.

Peppa and her family are going for a drive. Suddenly their car breaks down, and it has to go to Granddad Dog's garage to be fixed. While their car is fixed, they borrow a shiny new, blue car from Granddad Dog.

We are reading Blue's Clues to figure out what book Blue wants to read for story time. While looking for clues we practise letter recognition and sound, help Mr Salt and Mrs Pepper with their grocery list and skidoo into a book!
Paddington, Jonathan and Judy are worried they've used up all of Lucky the dog's luck, and Baaz wants to create the perfect pizza to surprise his visiting niece Simi.
pr.sub: Paddington's Lucky Day; Paddington the Pizza Chef

pr.d: Holly spends the day with King Thistle on his royal duties. King Thistle must launch an elf boat, judge a fairy fruit competition and make a speech at the festival.

Everyone is visiting snooty King and Queen Marigold's Castle. King and Queen Marigold give them a tour which features a room made of ice sculptures and an upside down room. However, the tour is not without a few mishaps.
A cake sale is organised to mend the magic school, but Queen Thistle is baking and no one can eat her cakes.
Queen Thistle reads the children a story, which inspires a question. They can't find the answer in the magic books in the castle, so they go to the Wise Old Elf in the Great Elf Library.
Peppa and George discover frogs, worms and butterflies in Granny Pig and Grandpa Pig's garden, and they play with them. Then Peppa, George and Grandpa have fun jumping in muddy puddles.
Peppa and George make everyone laugh when they dress up as Mummy and Daddy Pig.
Peppa gets shiny new red shoes and never wants to take them off, until it's time to jump in muddy puddles.
Peppa and the Pig family attend a school fête. Peppa's favourite things at the fête are face painting, the balloons, and the bouncy castle.

Peppa and her family are going for a drive. Suddenly their car breaks down, and it has to go to Granddad Dog's garage to be fixed. While their car is fixed, they borrow a shiny new, blue car from Granddad Dog.
Grandpa Pig hides some pirate treasure in his garden, and when Peppa and George come, they have to look for it, using a map and following the clues.
Peppa is feeling unwell and Doctor Brown Bear says she must stay in bed. Peppa's friends come to cheer her up.
Peppa and George have fun in the snow, as they make footprints, snowballs and build a snowman.
It's Gabby's birthday and the Gabby Cats have prepared surprises for her, including CatRat, who showed her the Dollhouse's new room, the Party Room!
Paddington has to decide whether to support England or Peru before the football match, but he loves both countries. It's time for Aunt Lucy to go home, but there's still time for one last adventure.
pr.sub: Paddington's Football DIlemma; Paddington Has to Say Goodbye

pr.d: When King and Queen Thistle ask Nanny Plum and the Wise Old Elf to build a boat capable of beating the Marigolds, the old rivals cannot help trying their best to outdo each other, with hilarious consequences.
Holly and Ben think Gaston the Ladybird is sad so they try and cheer him up by tidying his cave, but Gaston liked his cave just as it was, all messy and untidy.
King Thistle is bored in the Royal Castle and takes up the hobby of birdwatching. Using his magic bird book, the King is pleased when another creature makes a nest in the Royal Castle.
Granny Thistle comes to visit and gives Daisy and Poppy a powerful magical wand. The children escape from the castle and go bananas.
It's CatRat's birthday! Help Gabby and the gang plan a super-secret surprise party for their feline friend and his very special guest, Fluffy Flufferton.
Grandpa Pig takes Peppa and George to the playground, but does not understand the children's rules.
Peppa and her family visit a new theme park where there is lots of fun to be had with vegetables.
Peppa and George visit Daddy Pig's office and meet his colleagues. Mr Rabbit works with numbers, while Mrs Cat seems to spend her time drawing shapes on a computer.
Peppa's family is staying at Cousin Chloe's house. It's been a long day and everyone is tired and sleepy, but baby Alexander keeps everyone awake with his crying.

It's time for playgroup, and Peppa and friends are thinking about what they want to be when they grow up. Some in the group want to be nurses, police officers and even pirates, but Peppa takes a little while to figure out what she wants to be.

What's that strange creature hovering in the sky? It's George's dinosaur balloon, but little George is finding it difficult to keep hold of his big balloon. Can anyone stop it from flying off to the moon?
Peppa and her family visit Uncle Pig, Aunty Pig and Cousin Chloe. Chloe has a new puppet theatre, and she helps Peppa and George to make puppets. After lunch, they put on a very funny puppet show.
Peppa's family gets caught in a very long traffic jam whilst on the way to have lunch with Granny and Grandpa Pig.
Madame Gazelle gives the class a music lesson. There's lots of crashing and banging at first, but it's not long before the grown-ups visit and lay down some notes of their own.
Madame Gazelle shows Peppa and her school friends how to make a time capsule, with each of them putting one of their favourite things in the capsule and burying it in the school garden.
When Peppa goes for a sleepover at Zoe Zebra's house with Suzy Sheep, Rebecca Rabbit, Candy Cat and Emily Elephant, the girls are too excited to go to sleep.
Peppa and her friends play some very active games in the garden.
Miss Rabbit's Rescue Service has saved many people from tricky situations, but what happens when Miss Rabbit needs rescuing herself.
Peppa learns that Mummy Pig used to keep a diary when she was her age, so Peppa decides to give it a try.
George and Peppa spend the day playing golf with Grandpa Pig, but they are much more interested in the colourful mini-golf course next door.
Peppa and George go sailing with Grandpa Pig, but when he keeps getting stuck in the mud, they all decide to have a sleepover on the boat while they wait for the tide to come back in.
Chickaletta makes a brave move after Mayor Humdinger takes away Farmer Al's super seeds. The pups must find Katie and Cali's stolen tiaras before the 'Twin It to Win It' pet show.
pr.sub: Pups Plus a Plucky Chicken; Pups Save a Pet Show

pr.d: Daring Danny X straps a rocket booster to his pogo stick to attempt the most X-treme pogo jump ever. When Francois' big stunt show goes horribly awry, the Air Rescue pups are on a roll. However, two out-of-control hot air balloons wreak havoc.
pr.sub: Pups Stop a Rocket-Powered Pogo Stick; Pups Save the Sky-High Stunt Show

pr.d: After smelling Granny Pig's perfume de lavender, Peppa experiments with the flowers in the garden to create her own special smell.
Peppa is feeling unwell and Doctor Brown Bear says she must stay in bed. Peppa's friends come to cheer her up.
George is upset when he loses his favourite toy, Mr Dinosaur. Peppa becomes a detective to track it down.
Peppa Pig is excited on Christmas Day and so is Grandpa Pig who gets the biggest present.
Granny Pig is really pleased with all the plastic gnomes and wishing well she's got for the garden. Peppa and George love them too, but Grandpa Pig wishes they would all disappear.
Peppa and her family visit a museum, and Peppa likes the Kings and Queens room, whereas George's favourite is the dinosaur room.
When the police visit the school, officers Panda and Squirrel teach Peppa and her friends all about bicycle safety.

Daddy Pig receives a letter saying he must go away on business to test some very important concrete. Peppa, Mummy and George all decide to go with Daddy and enjoy a train journey, where they sing to pass the time.
When a greedy queen casts a spell to make these friends go slow, Blaze and AJ must race her for the magical cure.
Mr. Curry is sure there's a monster in the park lake, and Paddington sets out to help him prove it.
pr.sub: Paddington and the Lake Monster; Paddington's Space Radio

Peppa loves secrets, so Mummy Pig makes her a special box to put secret things in.
Peppa, George, Mummy and Daddy enjoy flying a kite in the park until their kite gets tangled in a tree beside a big, muddy puddle.
When Daddy Pig and Mummy Pig are tidying up the house, they happen to find an old box of musical instruments. George makes a loud sound with the Swiss horn.

After Peppa's tooth falls out, Mummy Pig explains that the Tooth Fairy will come that very night to take the tooth and leave a shiny coin in its place. Peppa plans to stay awake all night to see the Tooth Fairy.
Peppa and George wake up one morning to find that all the rain has made a flood, and their house is now a desert island.
pr.sub: The Biggest Muddy Puddle in the World

pr.d: Peppa and George are playing in Grandpa Pig's garden when they find a little snail.
There's a spider in the house. Mummy Pig tells Daddy Pig to get rid of it. Mr Skinny-Legs is set free in the garden, where he can spin all the webs he likes.

Peppa and George's toy basket is full, and their beds are covered in toys, so Mummy Pig decides it is time to order a new toy cupboard. The cupboard arrives in the post, but it needs to be assembled - and Mummy and Daddy Pig are not very good at DIY. Luckily help is at hand, as Mr Zebra the Postman loves assembling flat-pack furniture.
It's fruit day at the market and Miss Rabbit is making smoothies from people's favourite fruit. She gives George a special 'dinosaur' juice to make him big and strong.
Peppa and George want to jump in muddy puddles, but Mummy tells them to go in the pool instead.
Delphine the donkey comes to stay. Peppa takes Delphine to playgroup, where they teach her the 'Bing Bong Song'.
Grandpa Pig needs help when his boat sinks, so Granddad Dog gives them all a lift to Grampy Rabbit's Boatyard so that the boat can be fixed.
Peppa and her family spend Christmas in Australia, on the beach with Kylie Kangaroo. Kylie has never seen snow, but she is given a special Christmas present: a snow globe.
It's Daddy Pig's birthday, but he has to go to work, so while he's away, Mummy Pig, Peppa and George prepare a special birthday surprise.
Grandpa and Granny Pig dust off their motorbike and sidecar to take Peppa and George on a trip. They go to the beach and camp in a tent that folds out of the sidecar.
Peppa and George wake up in Granny and Grandpa's motorbike tent by the sea. Peppa finds a message in a bottle with a telephone number on it.
Mummy Pig shows Peppa how to play pretend by teaching her how to wink. Zoe Zebra comes to play with Peppa and brings along her toy monkey. Peppa pretends Monkey has a cough.
Police Officer Panda and Police Officer Squirrel visit Peppa's playgroup. They offer two lucky children the chance to spend the day with them.
Peppa and George explore the greenhouse, and it is full of lovely tomatoes and basil. When it is time for dinner, Granny Pig takes all the ingredients they have grown and makes a tasty salad.

SpongeBob und Patrick bauen in SpongeBobs Wohnzimmer eine Minigolf-Anlage auf. Allerdings verlagert sich das Spiel in Thaddäus Haus, außerdem will SpongeBob alle Andenken an Erlebnisse mit Patrick aufbewahren, und wird zum krankhaften Sammler.
Patrick presents a show about food after missing out on a hearty breakfast; Patrick and SpongeBob experience the wonders of the workforce.

Die Bewohner von Bikini Bottom starten ein großes Schlittenrennen zum Süd-Pol, und wer gewinnt, wird mit einer Million Dollar belohnt. Natürlich wollen alle gewinnen und reich werden, allerdings ist keinem bewusst, dass Plankton dahintersteckt.
Patrick and Grandpa try to pass each other on the stairs, leading to a ludicrous conflict. Members of the Star family confront their absurd rivalries.
pr.sub: Stair Wars; Enemies a la Mode

pr.d: Patrick hat plötzlich einen Bart, was Thaddäus hoffen lässt, dass aus ihm doch noch ein Mann wird. Er nimmt Pat unter seine Fittiche, was er schnell bereut. SpongeBob muss derweil ein Referat über bootomobile Sicherheit halten und ist sehr nervös.

When customers bring pets into the Krusty Krab, Mr. Krabs soon realises pets are more profitable than owners; Plankton ruins another date with Karen, so she puts the Chum Bucket on lockdown until he proves his affection.
pr.sub: A Place for Pets; Lockdown for Love

pr.d: Plankton will über Thaddäus an die geheime Formel kommen, was allerdings völlig nach hinten losgeht. Thaddäus will derweil mal wieder als Künstler durchstarten, macht aber stattdessen Patrick zum Star der Kunstwelt.
Squidward's house becomes infested with a mail-order flea circus meant for SpongeBob; Squidward fakes being sick to get out of work, but his agony only begins when SpongeBob arrives to care for him.
pr.sub: Under the Small Top; Squidward's Sick Daze

pr.d: Familie Schwammkopf fährt in den Urlaub und Patrick darf mitkommen, doch leider läuft in diesem Urlaub nichts so, wie es eigentlich sollte. Erst sind Sponge und Pat enttäuscht, doch dann stellen sie fest, wie viel Spaß sie trotz allem hatten.

Phoebe drags Billy and Nora to the park to meet her crush and his baby brother, but when Max takes the younger kids home, they accidentally grab the wrong one. The children wind up bringing home a real baby instead of Nora's doll.

Patrick braucht dringend Urlaub, ist aber pleite, also macht sich SpongeBob ans Werk, um seinem Freund zu helfen. Mit Planktons Hilfe gewinnt Mr. Krabs eine Kreuzfahrt. Um Ruhe zu haben, nimmt er SpongeBob und die Geheimformel mit.
pr.sub: Hotel mit einem Seestern; Zweite Flitterwochen

pr.d: Phoebe and Cherry's friendship is put to the test after only one of them makes the cheerleading squad. When Max wins a contest for a month of free pizza, he is accused of cheating.

Sandy ist auf dem Weg in den Urlaub auf dem Mond - doch durch ein Versehen landet auch SpongeBob in der Rakete. Perla kann ihren Vater Mr. Krabs endlich zu einem Urlaub überreden - und sie weiß genau, was sie nicht will.
pr.sub: Der Schwamm im Mond; Mr. Krabs macht Ferien

pr.d: Charlotte and Jasper must come to the rescue when Captain Man and Kid Danger are each stuck in a hole.

SpongeBob und Patrick haben mal wieder Ärger am Hals, denn sie sollen für eine Geisterschiffscrew ein Ersatzteil für den Bootsmotor besorgen. Wenn sie das nicht tun, bekommen sie ihre Seelen, die die Geister ihnen abgenommen haben, nie wieder.
When Dr Minyak takes the Man Fans hostage, Captain Man and Kid Danger have to find a way to rescue them without Dr Minyak seeing them move.

In der Höhle der Superhelden erfahren Patrick und SpongeBob, wie deren Geschichte begann. Karen macht indes eine für sie erstaunliche Entdeckung. Ihr fällt auf, dass ihr Gatte Plankton einen wesentlichen Defekt hat, weil er einäugig ist.
pr.sub: Meerjungfraumann: Wie alles anfing; Abgrundguter Plankton

pr.d: Stan sees Twister eating fish and hides a tracker in one, so he knows Twister's every move. Thanks to the Marsupilamis, Jade looks like an expert at parkour with Mica filming her moves.

SpongeBob schaut sich die Träume seiner Freunde an, die das jedoch nicht so lustig finden, außerdem ist SpongeBob krank. Er hat den Blubber und traut sich nicht zum Arzt, Patrick versucht ihn zu heilen.

Es ist Valentinstag und SpongeBob hat für Patrick ein besonderes Geschenk. Pat ist zu ungeduldig und denkt, dass SpongeBob ihm nichts schenkt, was ihn sehr wütend macht, außerdem will SpongeBob Thaddäus zeigen, wie toll ein Stück Papier ist.
pr.sub: Das Valentins-Geschenk; Ein kleines Stück Papier

pr.d: Plankton gibt sich als SpongeBobs Uroma aus, um an das Rezept für Krabbenburger zu kommen. Gary zieht Münzen magnetisch an und wird deswegen von Mr. Krabs für einen Raubzug missbraucht, den beiden steht großes Unheil bevor.
pr.sub: Besuch von Omama; Für eine Handvoll Kleingeld

pr.d: Handy invents a camera, so Painter can make portraits of all the village's inhabitants.

Dwayne is a huge fan of Lily's waffles, but she refuses to make any more for him. So he decides to get his revenge. Diaper Daddy feels neglected among the Smurfs and decides to go in search of a place where he will be loved.

Patrick trifft ein Monster und freundet sich mit ihm an. Natürlich lernt auch SpongeBob das Monster kennen und findet es ebenfalls super, allerdings ist es tollpatschig, was die Bürger der Stadt verärgert. Bikini Bottom gerät in ein Bermuda-Dreieck.
pr.sub: Legenden aus Bikini Bottom - Monsterbesuch in Bikini Bottom; Legenden aus Bikini Bottom - Willkommen im Bikini-Bottom-Dreieck

pr.d: Papa Smurf is nervous about the new Nature Fairy coming to visit so he asks Willow to teach the Smurfs manners.
Dwayne is turned into a tracker dog to help his uncle to catch the Smurfs: he has been promised a Snap. Gargamel bewitches Meteorite's drum and hypnotises the Smurfs.

Mr. Krabs handelt sich durch seine geizige Art einen Fluch einer alten Dame ein und SpongeBob und Mr. Krabs müssen dies nun rückgängig machen. Sponge und Patrick suchen nach dem Haupt-Ablassstopfen, durch den das Wasser des Meeres abgelassen wird.
pr.sub: Der Fluch des Banns; Kein Meer mehr

pr.d: SpongeBob and Patrick work a day on Old Man Jenkins' farm, much to his dismay. Sandy narrates the nocturnal adventures of Gary and his secret pal, Spot.

SpongeBob und Patrick finden sich nach einem Absturz bei den tiefsten Hinterdeichlern wieder und versuchen, sich zu arrangieren. Obwohl es ihm wehtut, muss Thaddäus wegen eines ausbrechenden Vulkans, SpongeBob wieder um Hilfe bitten.
Patrick inducts SpongeBob into his prestigious society of dullards and doofuses. Patrick takes his grime to a new extreme, playing around in so much rubbish that he becomes unrecognisable.
pr.sub: The Nitwitting; The Ballad of Filthy Muck

pr.d: SpongeBob muss sich auf die weite Reise zum Geheimversteck der Geheimformel machen, weil in der Krossen Krabbe die Krabben Burger ausgehen. Er muss dafür mit dem Ozeanien-Express fahren, doch er ist nicht allein auf seiner Reise.

Patrick und SpongeBob legen ein Tunnelsystem unter Bikini Bottom an, weil sie nicht mehr auf das Grundstück von Thaddäus dürfen. Patrick entpuppt sich dabei als enormes Karatetalent, doch leider kann er sein neues Können nicht im Zaum halten.

pr.t: The Boss Baby: Back in Business
pr.d: A consultant becomes Boss Baby's worst nightmare after arriving at Baby Corp with zany ideas and setting his sights on the CEO's job.

SpongeBob isst Meerzwiebeleis und bekommt davon Mundgeruch. Alle meiden ihn deswegen. Pearl arbeitet jetzt in der Krossen Krabbe und krempelt den ganzen Laden um. Mr. Krabs kann sich nur schwer an die Änderungen gewöhnen.

pr.t: The Boss Baby: Back in Business
pr.d: On a trip to Chicago to see Gigi and Grandpa, Boss Baby comes face to face with an ambitious baby masquerading as an adult.

Dora hält einen wilden Oktopus-Swiper auf und rettet somit die Party. Dora trifft die Languste und Gitarristin Raquel und hilft ihr, ihre Gitarre rechtzeitig für einen Auftritt bei einem großen Musikevent wiederzubekommen.

To attend the Rat Bros' party, the trio tries to get their hands on the latest cool item known as pogo sticks. Rock tries to get a job at Evil Robot Corp. Paper and Scissors see if the company is exactly what it sounds like.

Tim und Kai wollen Schätze ausbuddeln, die am Strand vergraben sind. Tim entrümpelt seinen alten Kram, merkt aber bald, dass nicht alles für die Mülltonne ist. Gemeinsam wollen Tim, Tia und Tommy Mum und Dad überreden, ein Haustier anzuschaffen.

After trashing a highway with litter, the Stars are forced to work on roadside clean-up duty. When Squidina shoots a documentary about GrandPat, GrandPat wants to show her how exciting his life really is.

pr.t: Paw Patrol - Helfer auf vier Pfoten
pr.d: Herr Porters neuer Roboter hilft in der Cafeteria, aber er hört nicht mit dem Putzen auf. Die Welpen müssen das hinterlassene Chaos aufräumen. Der Bürgermeister droht damit, die Stadt unter einem Wirbelsturm zu begraben.
SpongeBob and Patrick crash Squidward's yoga class. Patrick accidentally swaps voice boxes with an intimidating mobster.

Er hat einen Beo aus dem Dschungel mitgebracht und als dieser sich mit Henriette und Bertha zusammen tut, ist Chaos vorprogrammiert. 2. Geschichte: In der Abenteuerbucht findet ein Seifenkistenrennen statt. Alex und Danny nehmen auch daran teil. Orla versucht sich nach ihrer Entlassung mit Kyle zu versöhnen. Ermutigt von Marie-Louise und Kelsey stellt sich Abi ihrer tiefen Trauer in der Gruppentherapie. Kelseys Pläne geraten nach einer übereilten Entscheidung ins Wanken.

Drei Kindheitsfreundinnen in ihren Vierzigern fahren zur Côte d'Azur im Süden Frankreichs, um eine Ferienwohnung aufzuräumen. Dort wird Cécile, Sonia und Elise schnell bewusst, dass sie immer noch eine sehr attraktive Ausstrahlungskraft auf das andere Geschlecht haben. Sie treffen auf drei jüngere Männer, die starkes Interesse an den Frauen zeigen, die alle langfristig single oder frisch getrennt sind.

Der kleine Savill Kent wird grausam ermordet aufgefunden. Der Fall schlägt Wellen in ganz England. Der Innenminister veranlasst, dass Inspektor Whicher von der Metropolitan Police nach Wiltshire geschickt wird, um den Mord aufzuklären.
pr.sub: Der Mord von Road Hill House

pr.d: Mr. Whicher lernt Susan Spencer in einem Pub kennen, in dem sie offensichtlich völlig fehl am Platz ist. Sie ist auf der Suche nach ihrer schwangeren Nichte Mary Spencer. Kurz darauf wird die junge Frau ermordet aufgefunden und der Verdacht fällt sofort auf den Vater ihres Kindes, Stephen Gann, der laut Zeugenaussagen nichts mehr von ihr wissen wollte.
pr.sub: Der Mord in der Angel Lane

pr.d: Pauline freundet sich mit Leonards Kumpel Daniel an und bemerkt, dass er mehr ist als nur ein oberflächlicher Gigolo. Währenddessen bereitet sich Leonard darauf vor, den `Fürstenhof' endgültig zu verlassen. Doch er bekommt mit, dass er in seinem neuen Job ein Zweigwerk im Ausland aufbauen müsste und somit keine Möglichkeit hätte, sich um Patrizia und die Kinder zu kümmern. Schweren Herzens entscheidet er sich gegen seinen Traumjob und beschließt, am `Fürstenhof' zu bleiben.

Pauline ist es peinlich, dass sie dachte, Leonard würde ihretwegen im "Fürstenhof" bleiben. Sie vertraut sich Daniel an und erzählt ihm auch zu dessen Erstaunen, dass Leonard Vater wird. Es kommt zu einem kleinen Streit zwischen den beiden Freunden, bei dem Leonard Daniel vorwirft, Pauline anzubaggern. Daniel hält dagegen, dass Leonard Pauline immer noch liebt, aber zu feige ist, zu seinen Gefühlen zu stehen.

Im Mittelpunkt stehen die emotionalen Liebes- und Familiengeschichten rund um das Personal und die Eigentümer des Luxushotels "Fürstenhof". Der Alltag wird bestimmt von tragischen Schicksalsschlägen, gemeinen Intrigen und turbulenten Liebschaften.

Barbara präpariert die Almhütte so, dass es den Anschein hat, als habe Friedrich sie umgebracht. Goran erwacht wenig später davor und sieht Friedrich mit blutigem Hemd aus der Hütte flüchten. Während Goran die Polizei ruft, macht sich Barbara auf den Weg, um unter falschem Namen ihre Therapie zu beginnen.

Der Jäger Jan Frenzel wird am frühen Morgen im Berliner Stadtwald durch den Bolzen einer Armbrust tödlich getroffen. Frank Stolze, der Vorsitzende des Jagdverbandes, vermutet, dass der Anschlag auf das Konto militanter Tierschützer geht.

Christian Oswald, der Inhaber der ischool, einer elitären Nachhilfeschule in Berlin, stürzt in eine Grube. Oswald wird schwer verletzt ins Krankenhaus eingeliefert. Offenbar wollte der Schulleiter die GPS-Daten einer Geo-Caching-Route überprüfen.

Thomas ahnt nicht, dass Simone ihm bei der Kostenplanung des Salzmuseums mit versteckten Kosten für eine Tiefgarage ein Bein stellt. So erwischt es ihn kalt, als sie ihn auf einer Pressekonferenz der Wählertäuschung bezichtigt und sofortige Neuwahlen fordert. Nora empfindet Lasses Zweifel an Eddas Medizinstudium-Wunsch als übergriffig. Doch Carla kann sie herunterkochen. Nora und Lasse versöhnen sich wieder, und er gestattet Nora, im Kiosk einen Lesezirkel abzuhalten.

Lasse mischt sich als Konsequenz nicht mehr in Noras Privatleben ein, schon gar nicht, wenn es um Edda geht. Nora bedauert seine Zurückhaltung und trauert insgeheim auch dem romantischen Date nach, das sie sich selbst vermasselt hat. Als jedoch aus einem Dinner for friends ein Treffen zu zweit wird, geben die beiden endlich ihrer Leidenschaft nach. Thomas kann Simones Vorwurf, leichtfertig mit Steuergeldern umzugehen, zunächst nicht entkräften.

Dr. Martin Stein liegt nach einem Autounfall auf der Intensivstation. Zwar ist er relativ schwer verletzt worden, doch es sieht so aus, als hätte er Glück im Unglück gehabt. Martin, der nicht aufstehen darf, fühlt sich auch schon wieder recht gut. Elena Eichhorn weicht nicht von seiner Seite. Die beiden nutzen die Zeit, um Zukunftspläne zu schmieden. Der Unfallverursacher ist immer noch flüchtig.

Reinhold Wollenberg kommt als Patient von Dr. Kaminski in die Sachsenklinik. Er laboriert an einer verschleppten linksseitigen Nebenhodenentzündung, die er seiner Frau Andrea, die selbst Urologin ist, verschwiegen hat. Er wollte sie nicht beunruhigen, denn Andrea will unbedingt ein Kind, und Reinholds Erkrankung kann im ungünstigsten Fall zur Unfruchtbarkeit führen.

Der Profifußballer Marco Verween befürchtet, von dem Videoblogger Gunther Lüttich geoutet zu werden. Lüttich, der für seine gründlichen Recherchen bekannt ist, will über schwule Fußballer berichten und Verween als Beispiel nennen.

Cornelia Gastner und Lutz Bender sind verzweifelt. Sie lieben einander, sind aber Halbgeschwister. Sie wurden von einem Gericht wegen Inzest zu drei Monaten verurteilt. Isa von Brede will den beiden klarmachen, dass sie keine Chance haben.

Auf der Trauerfeier des Werftbesitzers Rüdiger Ansbach wird die Witwe Christine als Mörderin ihres Mannes beschuldigt. Elmar Pierow, ein Freund von Ansbach, unterstellt ihr vor versammelter Trauergemeinde, aus Geldgier den eigenen Mann skrupellos umgebracht zu haben. Er fordert sofortige Ermittlungen, um das Verbrechen vor der Einäscherung der Leiche aufzuklären.

In einer Tanzschule bricht die hübsche Sonja Schenker bewusstlos zusammen und wird ins Krankenhaus eingeliefert. Ihrem Tanzpartner Robert Jordan wird vorgeworfen, sie beim Tanzen gegen eine Säule geschleudert zu haben.

Nach der gemeinsamen Nacht mit Lasse tritt Nora auf die Bremse. Sie fürchtet sich davor, jemanden wieder in ihr Leben und ihr Herz zu lassen. Zu groß ist das Risiko, dass ihr Geheimnis gelüftet wird und sie in Gefahr gerät. Aber Lasse bittet Nora um Klarheit. Henri will dem Glück von Edda und Theo nicht im Weg stehen und zieht sich zurück. Dennoch quält es ihn, zumal Theo nicht aufhört, von Edda zu schwärmen.

Henri ist unglücklich verliebt in Edda und schreibt ihr im Wechselbad der Gefühle ein Liebesgedicht. Edda findet es durch Zufall und schreibt es völlig erstaunt Theo zu. Theo klärt dieses Missverständnis natürlich nicht auf und steigt durch seine vermeintliche Dichtkunst gewaltig in der Achtung von Edda. Nora und Lasse freuen sich über ihr neues und enges Zusammensein, bis Lasse sich plötzlich aus heiterem Himmel gegenüber Nora abschottet.

Nachdem Felix Rosalie vor die Wahl gestellt hat, versteht sie, dass sie einen Fehler gemacht hat. Simon zeigt Rosalie die kalte Schulter. Doch diese packt ihr taktisches Geschick aus, indem sie Felix eine tränenreiche Liebeserklärung macht.

André zeigt sich zu Bens Überraschung versöhnlich wegen der Auseinandersetzung. Er befürchtet, dass die Sprache auf alte Briefe kommt, die Evelyn nach der Trennung an Simon geschickt hat. Werner zeigt sich großzügig. Nils tritt in ein Fettnäpfchen.

Captain Charles Shore wird auf der Straße von einem Inder verfolgt. Kurz darauf fliegt ein Stein durch ein Fenster seines Hauses, wodurch einer seiner Söhne leichte Verletzungen erleidet. Daraufhin bittet sein Vater Sir Edward Shore den mittlerweile als privaten Ermittler arbeitenden Mr. Whicher um Hilfe. Als der Verfolger von Charles tot aufgefunden wird, eskalieren die Ereignisse.

Im Auftrag von Sir Henry Coverly beschattet Mr. Whicher dessen Frau wegen des Verdachts der ehelichen Untreue. Er findet heraus, dass Lady Jane Coverly ein Verhältnis mit Matthew Thorogood hat. Nachdem er Sir Henry Bericht erstattet hat und es zu einem Scheidungstermin vor Gericht kommt, erscheint Matthew Thorogood trotz Vorladung nicht. Als Mr. Whicher der Sache nachgeht, findet er Matthew kurz darauf ermordet im Wald.

Der beliebte Fernsehmoderator Claude Lacombe wird unter mysteriösen Umständen ermordet. Die Zeitungen zögern nicht, von einem Mord der dritten Art zu sprechen und spekulieren, dass das Verbrechen von Außerirdischen begangen wurde.

pr.d: Paul journeys around the coast of the Long Island of Harris and Lewis, beginning on Scarp, travelling north to Great Bernera, then south-east to Scalpay. Der türkisblaue Sewansee in Armenien liegt in 1.900 Meter Höhe, eingebettet in eine einzigartige Hochgebirgslandschaft. Der Sewan ist das größte Süßwasserreservoir der Kaukasusregion. Deshalb sind der See und seine Uferzone seit 1978 Nationalpark.

Im Süden Armeniens liegt der Arevik-Nationalpark. Er ist das größte Naturschutzgebiet des Landes und Heimat vieler seltener Tierarten. Ihr Fortbestehen wird jedoch durch den Klimawandel sowie Pläne zur Öffnung einer Mine bedroht.

pr.t: Aileen: Life and Death of a Serial Killer
pr.d: This feature-length film examines Aileen's harrowing life, tracing her story from the freezing woods of Michigan to the steamy swamps of Florida, and features her closest friends, her lawyers and even her estranged birth mother. At the heart of the film are the astonishing, unique, troubled interviews Broomfield filmed with Wuornos in prison, including her last, defiant words before execution.
Harold Shipman was a respected doctor, but he was killing his older patients. His murder spree has claimed at least 215 lives and the families of the dead wanted him to pay in court.
A young man meets a mystery woman, then vanishes; and a teenage girl disappears walking home from school. Luckily a psychic saw everything.
A New Jersey woman is beaten to death with a hammer and, in Louisiana, a frenzied struggle leaves a young mother dead and her son beaten.
In Illinois, a teenage boy goes to a job interview and vanishes. In New Jersey, two women are abducted and brutally murdered.
When a single mother goes missing in California and a New Jersey woman's ex-husband kidnaps her kids, psychics help each family search for justice.

Following a team of experts as they investigate whether evidence exists that could challenge the conviction of a man in prison for a murder he denies. Every year, over 500 people in the UK are convicted of murder. A guilty verdict can only be challenged if new evidence comes to light. Inside Justice is a specialist charity led by Louise Shorter, supported by a panel of criminal lawyers, ex-police officers and forensics experts who offer assistance to prisoners who are protesting their innocence.

Louise investigates a case, looking for evidence that could present grounds to bring an appeal, and ultimately overturn the conviction of a Southampton man in prison for the murder of his secret lover.

Kenneth Kunz finds four of his family members murdered and one missing. Investigators must determine whether it was his mother, a local farm boy, or the rumoured family drug dealing connections that led to the brutal slayings.

The chief of police leads an investigation into what happened to his family friend and babysitter, who is reported missing when she doesn't come home from Christmas shopping, and is found beneath a snow bank weeks later.
A young police officer discovers the dark secret hidden in a neighbourhood restaurant.

When Erin Chorney disappears, suspicion falls on her ex-boyfriend Michael Bridges, the last person to have seen her. After investigators' searches come up empty-handed, they orchestrate an operation to woo Bridges into confessing her whereabouts.

pr.t: Aileen: Life and Death of a Serial Killer
pr.d: This feature-length film examines Aileen's harrowing life, tracing her story from the freezing woods of Michigan to the steamy swamps of Florida, and features her closest friends, her lawyers and even her estranged birth mother. At the heart of the film are the astonishing, unique, troubled interviews Broomfield filmed with Wuornos in prison, including her last, defiant words before execution.
A thunderstorm ruins a family trip; a double murder horrifies a community.
A mother disappears in Oregon; a California woman does not return home.
The murder of an elderly couple shocks a small town in New York; an Ohio woman goes missing.
An Arkansas teen has been abducted. In California, a young man vanishes, leaving no clues. Psychics help both families to find answers.
Inside Justice investigates the conviction of Glyn Razzell, found guilty of his wife's murder. Glyn maintains his innocence, and now there's an alleged link with a double murderer.
Louise investigates a possible link between Linda and Halliwell and arranges for a polygraph test.

In the small community of Gormania, W.Va., Cathy Ford receives a mysterious phone call and is reported missing that same evening. A burnt car, blood-soaked trailer and a secret affair all point to the idea that Cathy did not disappear willingly.
James Duncan's family's search for him halts when the details of his murder are revealed, and they are almost as shocking as the murderer's identity.
Investigators, family, and the small town of Logan race against the clock to bring Summer Inman home alive after she is violently abducted.
When a quiet bachelor lets a mysterious woman into his life, the results are disastrous for both him and his family.
When Jake Millison vanishes without a trace, his loyal friends stop at nothing to unearth the shocking truth behind that fateful night.

pr.t: Jack the Ripper: London's Most Notorious Killer
pr.d: Unmasking Jack the Ripper and his evil deeds with a presentation of both factual evidence and conspiracy theories.

pr.t: Jack The Ripper: The German Suspect
pr.d: Ripper detective Trevor Marriott presents convincing new evidence surrounding the identity of Jack The Ripper, enabling him to trace living descendants of the Whitechapel murderer.
The Tasmanian tiger was once thought to be long extinct, but recent evidence invokes a special team to track it down. A large den and footprints generate excitement.

Go on an expedition beyond the bars of 12 of Western Germany's most popular zoos, get up close to some of the most intriguing animals on the planet, and witness their undisturbed behaviours and fascinating social interactions.
Many exotic animals that are threatened in the distant wilderness find a refuge in zoos in Europe.

In this first part we look at the state of nature in Central Europe. From the peaks of the Alps to the marshes, from the farmlands to the coasts. Unique images provide insight into this familiar, yet often still unknown habitat.

We see meadows, moors and coasts from their most beautiful side and get to know the animals that live there. But we are also confronted with the problems that exist and the state of our environment. Nitrogen is an ever-increasing danger.

The Alblasserwaard is the habitat of black-tailed godwits, purple herons, hares, barnacle geese, roe deer, moor frogs, marsh harriers and argus butterflies. The animals are followed at defining moments in their lives.
A look at how nature took over one of Europe's largest abandoned industrial zones in Germany's Ruhr area after 150 years.
Showcasing how the world's fastest predators can strike and kill in the blink of an eye, using modern high-speed cameras to capture these lightning-fast attacks in deadly detail.
In the battle between predator and prey, camouflage and speed often make the difference between life and death, as some of the fastest animals can strike and kill in the blink of an eye.

pr.t: Jewels Of The Alps: Italy's Great Lakes
pr.d: Lake Como is distinguished by its fauna and flora. The Pian di Spagna Nature Reserve is a haven for migratory birds, and Giardino della Valle di Cernobbio, an ancient landfill transformed into a garden, reveals its natural treasures.

pr.t: Jewels Of The Alps: Italy's Great Lakes
pr.d: Lake Garda is home to countless water birds, Mediterranean plants, and exotic insects, which coexist near the remains of ancient civilisations.
In the isolated land of Tasmania, there existed a flesh eating marsupial that was the apex predator. Thought to be extinct, new evidence suggests the creature still roams.
The Tasmanian tiger was once thought to be long extinct, but recent evidence invokes a special team to track it down. A large den and footprints generate excitement.
Jessica is looking to go beyond the surfing experience and see what more the ocean has to offer.
David and his team strive to make marine biologist Erica's dream of swimming with humpback whales come true.
David and his crew help Monwa, whose relationship to the marine environment is based on fear.
Showcases the interesting animals who call the Singapore Botanic Gardens home, including a young monkey learning about survival and a red-legged crake raising her chick in secret.
Showcases the lives of a white-breasted waterhen and orphaned lesser whistling ducklings in the Singapore Botanic Gardens.
Asiatic lions hunting in the Gir Forest, tigers pursuing deer and peacocks fighting cobras all help to explain the connection between religion and the animal kingdom.
The wildlife that lives along the sacred rivers of the Ganges and the Brahmaputra, from rhinos to elephants and gharials.
The marine life, from the very small to the very large, that survives in the Arabian Sea and the Bay of Bengal.
An insight into the Coral Triangle, with more than three quarters of the planet's coral species, and both the world's smallest and largest fish.
An exploration of the Coral Triangle's bays, lined with volcanic ash and mud, with their strange marine adaptions.
Explores the world's largest living structure: the Great Barrier Reef on the eastern coast of Australia.
The initial settlers of this island, confronted with lava-riddled rocks and iguanas that bear a striking resemblance to dinosaur descendants, dub it the "Island of the Damned".
The Galapagos has two main seasons: from January to June, there is a rainy and hot monsoon season, while from July to December, there is the dry season.

Die Polizei ist auf der Suche nach einem gestohlenen Huhn, allerdings finden sie bei der Suche eine männliche Leiche. Diese Leiche trägt statt des eigenen Kopfes einen Hühnerkopf und alles deutet auf einen Ritualmord hin.

Ein totes Popsternchen in einer Gasse sorgt für enormes Aufsehen. Bei den Ermittlungen im wilden Partyleben machen Castle und Beckett eine Entdeckung, denn das Opfer ist nur ein Double. Um den Star zu schützen, nimmt Castle sie in Obhut.

Die Assistentin der berüchtigten Herausgeberin einer Modezeitschrift wird tot aufgefunden. Castle und Beckett ermitteln in der schillernden Welt der Haute Couture. Gleichzeitig sind sie vollauf mit Hochzeitsvorbereitungen beschäftigt.

Der Mitinhaber eines Sportstudios, Chad Parkman, wird sterbend mit einer Stichwunde in seinem Hotelzimmer aufgefunden, nachdem der Sicherheitschef des Hotels Kämpfe gehört und die Tür aufgebrochen hat. Vom Mörder fehlt jedoch jede Spur! Er kann weder durchs Fenster noch durch die Tür entkommen sein. Da Parkman Mitglied der Visualize-Sekte des Sektenführers Bret Stiles war, ermittelt Patrick Jane zunächst in diese Richtung. Doch dann taucht ein weiterer Toter in einem Auto auf.

Die von Red John ermordete Kira Tinsley hat Patrick Jane kurz vor ihrem Tod anvertraut, dass Red John eine Tätowierung hat: Drei Punkte auf seiner Schulter. Patrick Jane will alle verbliebenen Red-John-Verdächtigen zu einem gemeinsamen Treffen überreden, bei dem er herausfinden will, wer die Tätowierung trägt. Das Treffen gelingt, doch als Patrick sie mit vorgehaltener Waffe zwingt, ihre Schultern zu entblößen, erlebt er eine Überraschung.

pr.t: No Demo Reno - Umbau ohne Abriss
pr.d: Jenn wird engagiert, um dem frisch verheirateten Paar Ann und Bobby dabei zu helfen, ein gemeinsames Zuhause zu schaffen, in dem sie sich eine Zukunft aufbauen können. Bobby hat Ann vor sechs Monaten geheiratet und ist in das Haus eingezogen.

Christina hilft Terri und Sam, das Schlafzimmer im Stil eines Fünf-Sterne-Resorts einzurichten, das ein doppelt so großes Bad und einen geräumigen begehbaren Kleiderschrank umfasst. Um das Budget zu schonen, bauen James und Christina eine Akzentwand.

Christina trifft Monica und Larry, die seit 2017 in ihrem Haus wohnen, aber mit dem beengten, unpraktischen Innenraum kämpfen. Die Küche ist zu eng, der Grundriss unübersichtlich. Schränke und Fenster sind problematisch.

All die investierte Mühe scheint vergeblich, als Ross durch einen Computerabsturz seine penibel erarbeitete Rede verliert, für die er extra nach Barbados gereist ist. Während er mit Charlie an einem neuen Vortrag arbeitet, keimen bislang ungekannte Gefühle in ihm auf. Auch Rachel hat mit unerwartetem Liebeskummer zu kämpfen: Obwohl sie sich krampfhaft zurückhält, hängt ihr Herz immer noch an Joey.

Mike und Phoebe haben wieder zueinander gefunden. Alles, was das junge Glück noch stört, ist der Umstand, dass Mike seit drei Monaten eine Freundin hat. Mike ist zwar fest entschlossen, mit ihr Schluss zu machen, doch das nimmt Phoebe lieber selbst in die Hand. Derweil funkt es gewaltig zwischen Rachel und Joey. Nach dem ersten Kuss plagt sie ihr schlechtes Gewissen gegenüber Ross - und sie würde auch gerne mit ihm darüber reden, aber wie?

Ross sieht das Techtelmechtel von Joey und Rachel viel entspannter als die beiden selbst. Schließlich sind Rachel und er seit sechs Jahren getrennt. Trotzdem haben Rachel und Joey Hemmungen, einander näherzukommen. Derweil ist Frank wegen der Drillinge mit seinen Nerven am Ende. Phoebe ist über seinen Vorschlag, ihm eines der Kinder abzunehmen, doch sehr verwundert. Auf gelegentliches Babysitten würde sie sich ja noch einlassen.

Die Assistenzärzte haben eine Menge zu tun. Während Josephine mit Alex zusammenarbeitet, verliert Jo komplett die Nerven, als eine Mutter ihr krankes Kind im Stich lässt. Sie wird an ihre eigene Vergangenheit erinnert und alte Wunden reißen auf.

Die Hochzeit von Bailey und Ben steht an. Bailey wird nervöser und hat Angst, dass in ihrer Abwesenheit alles drunter und drüber geht im Seattle Grace. Christina und Owen müssen es einsehen: Ihre Ehe ist am Ende, eine Scheidung nicht vermeidbar.

Lorelai überredet Luke, sein Lokal zu renovieren. Inzwischen lädt Rory Dean zu einem Abendessen ein, das unter dem Motto der 50er Jahre Serie "The Donna Read Show" steht. In dem Trubel geht Rory ein Küken, welches sie für ein Schulprojekt versorgen soll, verloren. Sogleich wendet sich Lorelai Hilfe suchend an Luke. Lorelais Reaktion bestätigt Emilys und Sookies Vermutung, dass sie mehr für Luke empfindet, als sie sich selbst eingesteht.

Die Ankunft von Rorys Vater Christopher sorgt für allerlei Turbulenzen. Bei einem Familienessen kommt es zu einem großen Streit zwischen Richard und Christophers Vater, der Lorelai vorwirft, das Leben seines Sohnes zerstört zu haben. Trotzdem landen Lorelai und Christopher anschließend zusammen im Bett, woraufhin er ihr überraschend einen Heiratsantrag macht.

Lukes Ex-Freundin Rachel taucht unvermutet auf. Sofort bemerkt sie, dass Luke und Lorelai mehr als nur Freundschaft verbindet. Die beiden bestreiten dies zwar, doch Rachels Anwesenheit bringt sie gehörig durcheinander. Rory und Dean feiern das dreimonatige Bestehen ihrer Beziehung. Als Dean ihr seine Liebe gesteht, zögert Rory mit einer Antwort. Dean ist so verletzt, dass er Schluss macht.

Rachel hilft Luke im Lokal aus. Lorelai kann ihre Eifersucht darüber nur schwer verbergen. Ein Besuch bei Max soll sie auf andere Gedanken bringen. Rory leidet unter der Trennung von Dean. Gemeinsam mit Lane besucht sie eine Party, um sich von ihrer Trauer abzulenken. Dort verliebt sich Lane Hals über Kopf.

Miranda versucht, Adeles Leben zu retten, während Ben weiter auf seine Braut wartet. Webbers Gefühlswelt steht kopf. Jedes Mal, wenn er sie ansieht, erinnert er sich, wie sehr er sie verletzt hat. Christina und Owen fühlen sich zueinander hingezogen.

Christina und Owen schweben auf Wolke sieben und können gar nicht mehr aufhören, miteinander zu flirten. Auch, dass Meredith ihr nichts von der Schwangerschaft gesagt hat, nimmt Christina ihr nicht übel. Owen soll auch Schuld an dem Absturz haben.
pr.sub: Das Ende ist der Anfang ist das Ende

pr.d: Lynette hat den Verdacht, dass sich Tom bereits mit einer neuen Frau trifft, während Bree Besuch von Tochter Danielle erhält und sehr überrascht ist, als sie die Wahrheit über deren neue Geschäftsidee herausfindet. Susan hingegen sucht nach Ablenkung und möchte einen Kunstkurs bei dem berühmten Künstler André Zeller absolvieren und Gaby legt sich mit Dana an, der Elternsprecherin an Juanitas Schule.

Susan ist entsetzt als ihr Kunstkurslehrer von den Teilnehmern verlangt, nackt aufzukreuzen. Bree kocht derweil für die Obdachlosen in einer Suppenküche ihre berühmte Suppe, was jedoch unerwünschte Entwicklungen mit sich bringt.

Halloween hält wieder einmal Einzug in der Wisteria Lane und hält für Bree, Gaby und die anderen einen ganz besonders großen Schock bereit, als sie erfahren, dass Ben genau auf dem Gelände ein Großbauprojekt starten will.
Während Bree erstaunt ist herauszufinden, wer im Besitz von Alejandros Leiche ist, erzählt Lynette ihrer ältesten Tochter Lügen über Toms neue Freundin Jane.

Die Welt von Tessa Young könnte nicht geordneter und perfekter sein mit dem Halt, den sie von ihrer Mutter und ihrem Freund bekommt. Doch das ändert sich schlagartig, als ihr neuer Lebensabschnitt an der Universität beginnt. Dort lernt sie Hardin Scott kennen, der so ganz anders ist als ihre vertraute Vorstellung vom Leben. Auch wenn sein Umgang mit ihr nicht von Freundlichkeit geprägt ist, fühlt sich Tessa auf magische Weise zu Hardin hingezogen.

Tessa kennt mittlerweile die Wahrheit über Hardin: Betrogen und gedemütigt beendet sie die Beziehung und wünscht sich ihr altes Leben vor Hardin zurück. Wären da nur nicht die Erinnerungen an Hardins leidenschaftliche Berührungen und Liebe. Entgegen allen Enttäuschungen und Verletzungen ist ihr Verlangen nach diesem Mann, der die Trennung wohl nicht so einfach akzeptieren wird, ungebrochen. Doch eine Fortführung der Beziehung, ohne dass Hardin sich ändert, ist für sie auch nicht möglich.

It is the first year of Germany's occupation of France. Allied officer Lt Aldo Raine assembles a team of Jewish soldiers to commit violent acts of retribution against the Nazis, including the taking of their scalps. He and his men join forces with Bridget von Hammersmark, a German actress and undercover agent, to bring down the leaders of the Third Reich. Their fates converge with theatre owner Shosanna Dreyfus, who seeks to avenge the Nazis' execution of her family.
Ace assassin Arthur Bishop becomes a target when he agrees to teach reckless Steve the art of contract killing.
A Secret Service agent springs into action to save the captive US President from the terrorists who attacked London.
America's national security team must rely on a disgraced former guard to save the president after terrorists seize control of the White House, taking the chief of state hostage.

A widowed farmer, with a brave but brutal military past, decides not to join up when the British arrive in 1776. However, when his son enlists and is later captured by the enemy, the former soldier must abandon his new-found pacifist principles in order to rescue his oldest child, and forms a regiment of Carolina patriots, whose guerrilla tactics prove pivotal to the US war effort.

The evil mummy Imhotep returns to wreak havoc as he resumes his relentless search for power and immortality. To make matters worse, another ancient evil has been unleashed, even more dangerous than Imhotep. Only the heroic Rick O'Connell and his intrepid Egyptologist wife stand in the way of these twin terrors as they embark upon a desperate mission to save the world.

In a time before the pyramids, an evil king threatens to take over the world, so the leaders of the remaining tribes under threat call upon a desert warrior to help them defeat the wicked one and his brutal hordes. As the warrior battles against the evil around him, he is preparing for a final showdown that will decide if it is to be his destiny to become the great Scorpion King.

pr.t: The Mummy: Tomb of the Dragon Emperor
pr.d: Beginning in ancient China, the ruthless Emperor Han will stop at nothing to gain control of the region. Many years on, in the 1940s, Han's tomb is discovered, and Rick O'Connell and his wife Evelyn get drawn into a plot to resurrect the emperor and restore him to power.

On a remote island, a wealthy entrepreneur creates a theme park featuring living dinosaurs drawn from prehistoric DNA. Before opening the attraction to the public, he invites a top palaeontologist, palaeobotanist, mathematician/theorist, and his two eager grandchildren to experience the park. Their park visit is anything but tranquil as the park's security system breaks down, and the prehistoric creatures break out.

Sequel in which the entrepreneur who genetically engineered the dinosaurs in Jurassic Park transpires to have cloned more of the prehistoric monsters on another island location. Researchers arrive to observe the creatures in their natural habitat, but hot on their heels is a band of mercenaries intent on capturing the dinosaurs and transporting them back to San Diego Zoo.

Dr Alan Grant reluctantly accompanies a rich couple who are searching for their teenage son who crashed on the second Jurassic Park island while paragliding. Unfortunately for the adventurers, there are many unfamiliar - and deadly - dinosaurs lurking in the jungle.

Jurassic Park is now called Jurassic World, a fully functional dinosaur park that sees 20,000 visitors a year, the realisation of owner John Hammond's dreams. The scientists may have gone too far in creating some sort of hybrid dinosaur, which escapes and terrorises the park.

Three years after the destruction of the Jurassic World theme park, Owen Grady and Claire Dearing return to the island of Isla Nublar to save the remaining dinosaurs from a volcano that's about to erupt. They soon encounter terrifying new breeds of gigantic dinosaurs, while uncovering a conspiracy that threatens the entire planet.

pr.d: A champion 🏁 [NASCAR] NASCAR driver's cosy position alongside his best friend at the top of the championship is threatened by a flamboyant French newcomer. With his confidence shattered, the driver draws on the help of his father and some eccentric training techniques to claw his way back to the top.

Jack Malik is a struggling singer-songwriter in an English seaside town whose dreams of fame are rapidly fading, despite the fierce devotion and support of his childhood best friend, Ellie. After a freak bus accident during a mysterious global blackout, Jack wakes up to discover that The Beatles have never existed. Performing songs by the greatest band in history to a world that has never heard them, Jack becomes on overnight sensation with a little help from his agent.
Four Los Angeles singles experience undeniable chemistry, and pair off to follow their attraction to its logical conclusion. Afterwards, each new couple tries to make love last in the real world.

Wealthy businessman, Zsa-Zsa Korda appoints his only daughter, a nun, as sole heir to his estate. As Korda embarks on a new enterprise, they soon become the target of scheming tycoons, foreign terrorists, and determined assassins.

Best friends Griff and Doug head to the jungles of the Amazon to film a reboot of their all-time favourite movie "Anaconda." However, life soon imitates art when a gigantic anaconda with a thirst for blood starts hunting them down.

West Virginia family man Jimmy Logan teams up with his one-armed brother Clyde and sister Mellie to steal money from the Charlotte Motor Speedway in North Carolina. Jimmy also recruits demolition expert Joe Bang to help them break into the track's underground system. Complications arise when a mix-up forces the crew to pull off the heist during a popular 🏁 [NASCAR] NASCAR race, while also trying to dodge a relentless FBI agent.
When her boyfriend takes her rent money, Alyssa and her roommate race against the clock to avoid eviction and keep their friendship intact.

Small-time pot dealer David learns the hard way that no good deed goes unpunished. Trying to help some teenagers, he is jumped by thugs and loses his cash and stash. Now David's in big debt to his supplier, and to wipe the slate clean, he must go to Mexico to pick up the guy's latest shipment. To accomplish his mission, Dave devises a foolproof plan: he packs a fake family into a huge RV and heads south of the border for a wild weekend that is sure to end with a bang.
A rivalry comes about between two best friends when they each schedule their respective weddings on the same day.

Chazz Michael Michaels and Jimmy MacElroy are the two titans of skating. At the 🏅 [Olympics] Winter Olympics, the fierce rivals find themselves forced to share the winner's podium when they both score gold. The shower of glory doesn't last for long, as the pair descend into fisticuffs and set the mascot on fire. Disgraced and stripped of their medals, they can get back on ice, but only if they dance with each other as a pair.

Clark Griswold sets out to give his family a traditional Christmas. While his in-laws, among them a cousin from hell, sample his hospitality, they find themselves battling against rabid squirrels, and an exploding sewer to achieve a family Christmas that they will never forget.
Needing a male heir to the throne, Prince Akeem returns to Queens, N.Y., to find his long-lost son and bring him back to Zamunda.

Propelled to the top of the fashion world by a photogenic gaze he calls 'Blue Steel,' dimwitted male model Derek Zoolander thinks he's got a fourth consecutive win as Male Model of the Year in the bag. However, when his rival, Hansel, unexpectedly takes the crown, Derek is crushed. He becomes easy prey for fashion designer Jacobim Mugatu, who signs Derek to star in his 'Derelicte' fashion show, then brainwashes him to kill Malaysia's prime minister.
The tragic story of 72-year-old Jane Hings, whose carers discovered her murdered in her bungalow home in Fleckney, Leicestershire, after 25-year-old Craig Keogh raped and killed her.
Mark Sievers refused to cooperate with the investigation into the brutal murder of wife Teresa, fuelling the suspicions police already had about him, but an unexpected hint helped solve the case.
Known as the 'Acid Bath Murderer', John George Haigh preyed on 1940s London with gruesome killings that saw him dissolve the bodies of his victims in acid before he poured the sludge down the drain.
From the pursuit of a drink driver to an escalating domestic dispute, police officers responding to incidents in West Wales have their work cut out for them.
In Central Otago, the highway cops tackle a motorist with an amusing excuse for his dangerous driving when he claims to be a 🏎️ [F1] Grand Prix champion.
It's the Highway Cops vs the wildlife of New Zealand as a pony on the loose causes havoc, and a cattle truck flips and plunges livestock into a river.
A driver on the run from police crashes into a stop sign and risks a head-on collision with a bus, and the question remains whether he will escape both the police and a serious smash.
Officers Damien O'Brien and Steve Mottram stop a woman who likes to let her dog ride shotgun even when her boyfriend is in the car.
A 12-year-old is caught driving, a scrub fire by the motorway causes chaos, and senior constables Errol Diprose and Sheryll Pearce stop a drunk driver who is back to their old tricks.
Cops find a drink driver with a bad attitude, and the police pursue stolen shampoo.

The Met's only father-and-son dog squad pairing are sent on a raid to a house suspected of being a cannabis factory. PCs John and Kevin Tozer both have German shepherds, and John's dog Charlie has reached the retirement age for police dogs. John is looking for a replacement for Charlie, but the old dog shows he still has plenty of life left in him when he sniffs out a man hiding following an attempted robbery.

Police are called to a major pile-up which threatens to close the road. Traffic examiners clamp down on dangerously overloaded vehicles, and there is a mammoth mission to deliver a couple's dream retirement home nearly two hundred miles up the A1.

Witness one of the most exciting UK pursuits ever as police chase a criminal at high speed through the grounds of Milton Keynes hospital ending with a smash into a group of parked cars. Also, an American cop cannot believe the driver he's stopped for speeding cannot see.

The City of London crime squad have their work cut out for them when a gang of suspected motorbike thieves try to flee from them, and there is trouble on the Underground that the police must attend to.
A countdown of the most incredible, hilarious, and spectacular real-life crashes in the world, all caught on dash cam.
An exploration of the crimes of serial killer Graham Frederick Young, who, after serving 15 years for poisoning his parents, laced an entire factory's tea with deadly thallium.
After a body is found, police identify the victim and trace CCTV to a Luton man. His chilling purchases and actions expose a shocking murder.
A look at the crimes of serial killer Chester Turner during his decade of terror in Los Angeles, analysing the police's efforts to capture him and the lives of the women he murdered.
A family's worst nightmare unfolded in 2015 when 16-year-old Becky Watts went missing from her home in St George, Bristol, before being found dead days later, murdered by her step-brother.
In 2002, mum Karen Doubleday was brutally murdered as she walked back to her home in Denton, and a crucial clue to finding her killer lay in pollen spores dating back to the Ice Age.

In 2008, the quiet village of Duddleswell found itself rocked when a dog walker discovered the body of missing television make-up artist Diane Chenery-Wickens, setting off a police investigation to unmask the murderer.
A murderer who goaded police and media during his spree, Heriberto Seda became known as 'The New York Zodiac' due to his claims that he killed based on the star signs of his victims.

When his parents are discovered dead, a man does everything he can to avoid being caught, but luminol reveals a trail of bloody footprints that gives him away to police investigators.
In January 2019, Hull student Libby Squire heads home from a night out, but when her friends realise that she has not made it back, a huge police search begins to find her.
As the police find evidence of Libby Squire entering an unknown vehicle, investigators make an arrest and receive calls pointing to a possible stalker.
As a body is discovered seven weeks after Libby Squire's disappearance, police try to find the evidence needed to charge the man they believe to be responsible.

Roxy Hart is sent to prison for shooting her lying lover. In prison, she meets tabloid darling and headline singer, Velma Kelly, who is also in for a double murder. With the help of a slick Chicago lawyer, she learns to play the media game and vies for the valuable press attention that will get her out of jail.

pr.t: The Boy in the Striped Pyjamas
pr.d: When his father's job results in a family move to the countryside, young German boy Bruno misses his old friends. Roaming the grounds of the large country house he now calls home, he discovers the huge fenced facility that his dad Ralf, a Nazi officer, now administers. Approaching it, Bruno meets Shmuel, a Jewish boy on the other side of the barbed wire, wearing what appears to be a pair of pyjamas.
When her father is murdered, 14-year-old girl Mattie Ross hires grizzled US Marshal Rooster Cogburn to track down the killer into hostile Indian territory. Based on Charles Portis' novel.

Frederick Manion, an army lieutenant, is arrested for the murder of bartender Barney Quill. In defence, he claims that the victim had beaten and raped his wife. With such evidence somewhat lacking, Manion's lawyer, Paul Biegler attempts to save his defendant from prosecution, setting his assistants in search of witnesses.
A teenage girl wants revenge on the man who killed her father, but she needs help from legendary one-eyed marshal "Rooster" Cogburn, and a Texas Ranger.

Sweeping epic about three sons raised on a Montana ranch by their father, a colonel who has turned his back on the army after the Indian Wars. Though the destinies of the boys are very different, two forces impact on each of their lives: the Great War in Europe and the love of a young woman. Covering several decades, the action ranges from majestic Montana to the battlefields of Europe and adventure on the high seas.

In 1991, talented figure skater Tonya Harding becomes the first American woman to complete a triple axel during a competition. In 1994, her world comes crashing down when her ex-husband conspires to injure Nancy Kerrigan, a fellow Olympic hopeful, in a poorly conceived attack that forces the young woman to withdraw from the national championship. Harding's life and legacy instantly become tarnished as she's forever associated with one of the most infamous scandals in sports history.

When petty criminal Luke Jackson is sentenced to two years in a Florida prison farm, he doesn't play by the rules of either the sadistic warden or the yard's resident heavy, Dragline, who ends up admiring the new guy's unbreakable will. Luke's bravado, even in the face of repeated stints in the prison's dreaded solitary confinement cell, 'the box' makes him a rebel hero to his fellow convicts and a thorn in the side of the prison officers.

pr.t: The Boy in the Striped Pyjamas
pr.d: When his father's job results in a family move to the countryside, young German boy Bruno misses his old friends. Roaming the grounds of the large country house he now calls home, he discovers the huge fenced facility that his dad Ralf, a Nazi officer, now administers. Approaching it, Bruno meets Shmuel, a Jewish boy on the other side of the barbed wire, wearing what appears to be a pair of pyjamas.
Sonny Vaccaro and Nike pursue basketball rookie Michael Jordan, creating a partnership that revolutionises the world of sports and contemporary culture.
A Secret Service agent-turned-bodyguard finds danger and romance while protecting an entertainer from a stalker.
